linkedin.title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone the same.
linkedin.body:
When you open a typical news app, you get a firehose of information. It is designed to capture attention, not to inform. You end up scrolling past dozens of stories that just do not matter to your life or your work.

We think news should be different. Personalisation should not mean just showing you more of what you already click on. That creates an echo chamber. True personalisation means filtering out the noise so you can find the signals that actually help you make better decisions.

Technology allows us to curate a feed that respects your time. It should be about giving you the full picture on the topics you care about, while skipping the fluff that is only there to keep you scrolling. Good AI acts like a smart editor, not a click-hungry algorithm.

slides.headline: Saudi Prince Urges Restraint
slides.explanation: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has reportedly asked President Trump to avoid escalating tensions with Iran. This intervention comes as the US considers new military strikes in the region.

slides.headline: Bombing Rocks Central Moscow
slides.explanation: A homemade bomb carried by a woman exploded near an Italian restaurant in Moscow, killing three people and injuring over 20. Authorities are currently investigating the incident.

slides.headline: Wildfire Forces Spokane Evacuations
slides.explanation: A fast-moving wildfire, fueled by high winds and heat, has jumped the Spokane River in Washington. Residents are being evacuated as crews work to contain the blaze.

slides.headline: Rising Anti-LGBTQ+ Laws in Africa
slides.explanation: Campaigners warn that several West African nations are implementing stricter anti-LGBTQ+ laws. Activists suggest politicians are using these measures to consolidate political power.

slides.headline: Vincent Pastore Dies at 80
slides.explanation: Actor Vincent Pastore, best known for his roles as mobsters and tough guys, has passed away at age 80. He was a familiar face in film and television for decades.
